checks: Paired lexical syntax generation; bounded debug/release and compiled assertion controls in receipt
cost: Seeding/uniform O(1) time and memory. Normal consumes a cached sample in O(1); rejection loop has no deterministic bound, expected constant under uniform draws.
description:
stream: Seed expansion applies four wrapping splitmix rounds; next_u64 returns rotl(s1*5,7)*9 then XOR/shift/rotl45 transition. Uniform=(result>>11)/2^53.

polar: Normal takes spare first; otherwise samples u,v in [-1,1), rejects s<=0 or s>=1, emits u*sqrt(-2ln(s)/s), caches v times same scale.
forward: stream: Seed expansion applies four wrapping splitmix rounds; next_u64 returns rotl(s1*5,7)*9 then XOR/shift/rotl45 transition. Uniform=(result>>11)/2^53.
polar: Normal takes spare first; otherwise samples u,v in [-1,1), rejects s<=0 or s>=1, emits u*sqrt(-2ln(s)/s), caches v times same scale.
inverse: stream: A uniform value admits all low11-bit result antecedents plus compatible state words. Output alone does not recover the seed.
polar: Observed cached z admits any unchanged four-word state paired with spare=Some(z); fresh z admits many accepted (u,v) and prior rejection histories.
limitations: All u64 seeds; IEEE f64 libm operations. Cross-platform transcendental bit identity is not proved.
